description: Competing Use Analysis for Offshore Renewables and Subsea Cables is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Benjamin Best, Levi Kilcher. Demand for abundant and diverse resources in the oceans is growing, necessitating marine spatial planning. To inform development of Marine Hydrokinetic (MHK) and Offshore Wind (OSW) resources, the Department of Energy (DOE) has asked NREL to identify the competing uses areas between promising MHK/OSW sites and submarine power and telecommunications cables. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
